        working-directory: expo
        env:
          NODE_OPTIONS: --max-old-space-size=6144
        run: bunx tsc --noEmit
      - name: Expo lint hard gate
        working-directory: expo
        run: bun run lint

  tests:
    name: Hard Unit + Regression Tests
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 45
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: oven-sh/setup-bun@v2
        with:
          bun-version: 1.3.9
      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          bun install --frozen-lockfile
          bun install --cwd expo --frozen-lockfile
      - name: Backend tests - every test file must pass
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          mapfile -t files < <(find backend -type f \( -name '*.test.ts' -o -name '*.test.tsx' \) | sort)
          echo "backend_test_files=${#files[@]}"
          failed=0
          for file in "${files[@]}"; do
            echo "=== $file ==="
            test_root="$RUNNER_TEMP/ivx-enterprise-${GITHUB_RUN_ID}-$(echo "$file" | tr '/.' '__')"
            mkdir -p "$test_root"
            if ! (cd "$test_root" && IVX_DATA_DIR="$test_root" NODE_ENV=test bun test "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/$file" --reporter=dots); then
              failed=$((failed + 1))
              echo "::error file=$file::Backend test failed"
            fi
            rm -rf "$test_root"
          done
          test "$failed" -eq 0
      - name: Expo tests - every test file must pass
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          mapfile -t files < <(find expo -type f \( -name '*.test.ts' -o -name '*.test.tsx' \) -not -path '*/node_modules/*' | sort)
          echo "expo_test_files=${#files[@]}"
          failed=0
          for file in "${files[@]}"; do
            echo "=== $file ==="
            if ! (cd expo && NODE_ENV=test bun test "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/$file" --reporter=dots); then
              failed=$((failed + 1))
              echo "::error file=$file::Expo test failed"
            fi
          done
          test "$failed" -eq 0
      - name: Critical file protection hard gate
        run: bun test qa/ivx-critical-file-protection.test.ts --reporter=dots

  module-registry:
    name: 222-Module Claim + Registry Integrity
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 10
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: oven-sh/setup-bun@v2
        with:
          bun-version: 1.3.9
      - run: bun install --frozen-lockfile
      - name: Audit module registry and real Expo screen inventory
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          bun -e "import { IVX_MODULE_REGISTRY, MODULE_COUNT, getScoreDistribution } from './expo/lib/ivx-module-registry.ts'; const expected=Number(process.env.EXPECTED_MODULE_COUNT||0); const ids=new Set(IVX_MODULE_REGISTRY.map(m=>m.id)); const nums=new Set(IVX_MODULE_REGISTRY.map(m=>m.number)); const blocked=IVX_MODULE_REGISTRY.filter(m=>m.status==='BLOCKED'); const failed=IVX_MODULE_REGISTRY.filter(m=>m.status==='FAILED'); const scores=getScoreDistribution(); console.log(JSON.stringify({expectedClaim:expected,moduleRegistryCount:MODULE_COUNT,uniqueIds:ids.size,uniqueNumbers:nums.size,blocked:blocked.map(m=>({id:m.id,name:m.name,workRemaining:m.workRemaining})),failed:failed.map(m=>m.id),scores},null,2)); if(ids.size!==MODULE_COUNT||nums.size!==MODULE_COUNT) process.exit(2); if(MODULE_COUNT!==expected) process.exit(3); if(blocked.length||failed.length) process.exit(4);"
      - name: Count real Expo screen route files
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          SCREEN_COUNT=$(find expo/app -type f \( -name '*.tsx' -o -name '*.ts' \) \
            ! -name '_layout.tsx' ! -name '+not-found.tsx' ! -name '*+api.ts' ! -name '*+api.tsx' | wc -l | tr -d ' ')
          echo "real_expo_screen_route_files=$SCREEN_COUNT"
          find expo/app -type f \( -name '*.tsx' -o -name '*.ts' \) \
            ! -name '_layout.tsx' ! -name '+not-found.tsx' ! -name '*+api.ts' ! -name '*+api.tsx' | sort > screen-inventory.txt
          cat screen-inventory.txt
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: enterprise-screen-inventory-${{ github.sha }}
          path: screen-inventory.txt

  security:
    name: Secrets + Configuration Security
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 15
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: Secret scan hard gate
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          failed=0
          for pattern in 'ghp_[A-Za-z0-9]{36}' 'github_pat_[A-Za-z0-9_]{60,}' 'sk-[A-Za-z0-9_-]{30,}' 'rnd_[A-Za-z0-9]{20,}' 'sbp_[A-Za-z0-9_-]{20,}'; do
            found=$(grep -r --include='*.ts' --include='*.tsx' --include='*.js' --include='*.mjs' --include='*.json' \
              --exclude-dir=node_modules --exclude-dir=.git --exclude='*.test.ts' --exclude='.env.example' \
              -E "$pattern" . 2>/dev/null || true)
            if [ -n "$found" ]; then
              echo "::error::Potential secret material matched pattern $pattern"
              echo "$found" | sed -E 's/[A-Za-z0-9_-]{12,}/[REDACTED]/g'
              failed=1
            fi
          done
          test "$failed" -eq 0
      - name: Store config hard checks
        run: |
          cd expo && node - <<'NODE'
          const fs=require('fs');
          // Evaluate the Expo config properly instead of fragile literal-text matching
          const { getConfig } = require('expo/config');
          const { exp } = getConfig(process.cwd(), { skipSDKVersionRequirement: true });
          const eas=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('eas.json','utf8'));
          const errors=[];
          const iosBundle = exp.ios?.bundleIdentifier;
          const androidPkg = exp.android?.package;
          if(iosBundle !== 'com.ivxholdings.app') errors.push(`iOS bundleIdentifier mismatch: got ${iosBundle}`);
          if(androidPkg !== 'com.ivxholdings.app') errors.push(`Android package mismatch: got ${androidPkg}`);
          if(eas?.build?.production?.distribution!=='store') errors.push('production distribution is not store');
          if(eas?.build?.production?.android?.buildType!=='app-bundle') errors.push('Android production build is not AAB');
          if(!eas?.submit?.production?.ios) errors.push('iOS submit config missing');
          if(!eas?.submit?.production?.android) errors.push('Android submit config missing');
          console.log(JSON.stringify({iosBundle,androidPackage,production:eas.build.production,submit:eas.submit.production},null,2));
          if(errors.length){ console.error(errors.join('\n')); process.exit(1); }
          NODE

    name: Playwright Web E2E Hard Gate
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 30
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: oven-sh/setup-bun@v2
        with:
          bun-version: 1.3.9

        run: bunx playwright test --config=playwright.config.ts
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        if: always()
        with:
          name: enterprise-playwright-${{ github.sha }}
          path: expo/playwright-report

  runtime-live:
    name: Production Runtime + Real AI Hard Gate
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 20
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: Wait for production exact SHA parity
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          matched=0
          for i in $(seq 1 90); do
            code=$(curl -sS -m 15 -o /tmp/health.json -w '%{http_code}' "$API_BASE/health" || true)
            if [ "$code" = "200" ]; then
              prod=$(jq -r '.commit // empty' /tmp/health.json)
              ok=$(jq -r '.ok // false' /tmp/health.json)
              echo "poll=$i ok=$ok production_sha=${prod:-missing} expected=$GITHUB_SHA"
              if [ "$ok" = "true" ] && [ "$prod" = "$GITHUB_SHA" ]; then matched=1; break; fi
            fi
            sleep 8
          done
          test "$matched" -eq 1
      - name: Database health must be configured
        run: |
          jq '.' /tmp/health.json
          test "$(jq -r '.databaseConfigured // false' /tmp/health.json)" = "true"
      - name: Live AI provider must be real, not fallback
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          curl -fsS --retry 3 --retry-delay 2 "$API_BASE/health/ai/live" -o /tmp/ai.json
          jq '.' /tmp/ai.json
          test "$(jq -r '.ok // false' /tmp/ai.json)" = "true"
      - name: Public chat must use real inference
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          curl -fsS --retry 3 --retry-delay 2 -X POST "$API_BASE/api/public/chat" \
            -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
            -H "x-ivx-client-id: enterprise-qa-${GITHUB_RUN_ID}" \
            --data '{"message":"Return only the number: what is 17 plus 25?","sessionId":"enterprise-qa","requestId":"enterprise-qa-'"$GITHUB_RUN_ID"'","history":[]}' \
            -o /tmp/chat.json
          jq '.' /tmp/chat.json
          answer=$(jq -r '.answer // .text // empty' /tmp/chat.json)
          source=$(jq -r '.source // empty' /tmp/chat.json)
          test -n "$answer"
          test "$source" != "fallback"

  android-build:
    name: Android Release Bundle Compile
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 60
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: oven-sh/setup-bun@v2
        with:
          bun-version: 1.3.9
      - uses: actions/setup-java@v4
        with:
          distribution: temurin
          java-version: '17'
      - uses: android-actions/setup-android@v3
        with:
          packages: 'platform-tools platforms;android-36 build-tools;36.0.0 ndk;27.1.12297006 cmake;3.22.1'
      - run: |
          bun install --frozen-lockfile
          bun install --cwd expo --frozen-lockfile
      - name: Build Android release AAB
        working-directory: expo/android
        env:
          JAVA_HOME: ${{ env.JAVA_HOME }}
          ANDROID_HOME: ${{ env.ANDROID_SDK_ROOT }}
        run: |
          chmod +x gradlew
          ./gradlew bundleRelease --no-daemon -x lint
      - name: Record bundle evidence
        run: |
          find expo/android/app/build/outputs/bundle -name '*.aab' -type f -print -exec sha256sum {} \;
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: enterprise-android-aab-${{ github.sha }}
          path: expo/android/app/build/outputs/bundle/release/*.aab
          if-no-files-found: error

  ios-simulator-build:
    name: iOS Simulator Build Hard Gate
    runs-on: macos-latest
    timeout-minutes: 60
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: oven-sh/setup-bun@v2
        with:
          bun-version: 1.3.9
      - run: |
          bun install --frozen-lockfile
          bun install --cwd expo --frozen-lockfile
      - name: Build and launch iOS simulator app
        working-directory: expo
        env:
          EXPO_PUBLIC_SOURCE_COMMIT_SHA: ${{ github.sha }}
          EXPO_PUBLIC_API_BASE_URL: https://api.ivxholding.com
        run: npx expo run:ios --configuration debug

  enterprise-certificate:
    name: Enterprise QA Certificate
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    needs: [code-quality, tests, module-registry, security, web-e2e, runtime-live, android-build, ios-simulator-build]
    if: always()
    steps:
      - name: Enforce all hard gates
        env:
          NEEDS_JSON: ${{ toJSON(needs) }}
        run: |
          echo "$NEEDS_JSON" | jq '.'
          failures=$(echo "$NEEDS_JSON" | jq '[to_entries[] | select(.value.result != "success")] | length')
          if [ "$failures" -ne 0 ]; then
            echo "ENTERPRISE_QA_CERTIFIED=false"
            exit 1
          fi
          echo "ENTERPRISE_QA_CERTIFIED=true"
          echo "SHA=${GITHUB_SHA}"

      - name: Install Expo dependencies
        run: cd expo && bun install

      - name: 1-10 Owner login code and regression gate
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          cd expo
          bun test __tests__/auth-timeout-fix.test.ts --reporter=dots
          grep -q '/api/members/login' lib/auth-context.tsx
          grep -q 'auth_timeout' lib/auth-password-sign-in.ts
          if grep -n "title: 'Aborted'\|message: 'Aborted'" app/login.tsx lib/auth-context.tsx lib/auth-password-sign-in.ts; then
            echo 'Opaque Aborted owner-login UI is still present'
            exit 1
          fi
          if grep -q "useRealtimeTable" app/owner-login.tsx; then
            echo 'Owner login still depends on Realtime subscription'
            exit 1
          fi
          grep -q 'OWNER_TRUSTED_DEVICE_WINDOW_MS' lib/auth-context.tsx
          grep -q "router.replace('/(tabs)/(home)/home'" app/login.tsx || grep -q "const target = '/(tabs)/(home)/home'" app/login.tsx
          echo 'owner_login_code_gate=PASS'

      - name: 11-20 Wait for production health
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          ok=0
          for i in $(seq 1 30); do
            code=$(curl -sS -m 20 -o /tmp/health.json -w '%{http_code}' "${API_BASE}/health" || true)
            echo "health poll=$i http=$code"
            if [ "$code" = "200" ]; then
              cat /tmp/health.json || true
              health_ok=$(jq -r '.ok // false' /tmp/health.json 2>/dev/null || echo false)
              db_config=$(jq -r '.databaseConfigured // .database_configured // false' /tmp/health.json 2>/dev/null || echo false)
              if [ "$health_ok" = "true" ] && [ "$db_config" = "true" ]; then
                ok=1
                break
              fi
            fi
            sleep 10
          done
          if [ "$ok" != "1" ]; then
            echo 'Production health gate did not pass — HARD FAIL'
            exit 1
          fi
          echo 'production_health_gate=PASS'

      - name: 11-17 Supabase Auth REST RPC and binding gate
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          cert_code=$(curl -sS -m 20 -o /tmp/member-cert.json -w '%{http_code}' \
            "${API_BASE}/api/ivx/certification/member-auth-public" || true)
          echo "member_auth_cert http=$cert_code"
          if [ "$cert_code" != "200" ]; then
            echo 'Member auth cert endpoint unavailable — HARD FAIL'
            exit 1
          fi
          cat /tmp/member-cert.json || true
          certified=$(jq -r '.certified // false' /tmp/member-cert.json 2>/dev/null || echo false)

          if [ "$code" = "401" ]; then

on:
  push:

jobs:
  reels-live-cert:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 12
    env:
      API_BASE: https://api.ivxholding.com
      LANDING_BASE: https://ivxholding.com
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Wait for production SHA parity
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          matched=0
          for i in $(seq 1 60); do
            code=$(curl -sS -o /tmp/health.json -w '%{http_code}' --connect-timeout 5 --max-time 15 "${API_BASE}/health" || true)
            if [ "$code" = "200" ]; then
              health_sha=$(jq -r '.commit // .sha // .gitCommit // .git_commit // empty' /tmp/health.json 2>/dev/null || true)
              ok=$(jq -r '.ok // false' /tmp/health.json 2>/dev/null || echo false)
              echo "poll=$i health=$ok production_sha=${health_sha:-missing} expected=${GITHUB_SHA}"
              if [ "$ok" = "true" ] && { [ "$health_sha" = "$GITHUB_SHA" ] || [[ "$GITHUB_SHA" == "$health_sha"* ]] || [[ "$health_sha" == "$GITHUB_SHA"* ]]; }; then
                matched=1
                break
              fi
            else
              echo "poll=$i health_http=$code"
            fi
            sleep 10
          done
          if [ "$matched" != "1" ]; then
            echo "Production never reached current main SHA ${GITHUB_SHA}"
            exit 1
          fi
          echo "sha_parity=PASS"

      - name: Verify production health
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          body=$(cat /tmp/health.json)
          ok=$(printf '%s' "$body" | jq -r '.ok // false' 2>/dev/null || echo false)
          if [ "$ok" != "true" ]; then
            echo "health endpoint did not return ok=true"
            exit 1
          fi
          echo "health=PASS"

      - name: Verify canonical Reels feed
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          code=$(curl -sS --retry 2 --retry-delay 2 \
            -D /tmp/reels-headers.txt \
            -o /tmp/reels.json \
            -w '%{http_code}' \
            "${API_BASE}/api/ivx/video-platform/feed?type=reel&limit=10" || true)
          echo "reels_http=$code"
          cat /tmp/reels.json || true
          echo
          if [ "$code" != "200" ]; then
            echo "Canonical Reels feed failed HTTP $code; response body printed above"
            exit 1
          fi
          jq '.' /tmp/reels.json
          feed_type=$(jq -r '.feed_type // empty' /tmp/reels.json)
          marker=$(jq -r '.marker // empty' /tmp/reels.json)
          count=$(jq -r '.count // (.videos | length) // 0' /tmp/reels.json)
          if [ "$feed_type" != "reel" ]; then
            echo "Expected feed_type=reel, got $feed_type"
            exit 1
          fi
          if [ -z "$marker" ]; then
            echo "Missing video platform marker"
            exit 1
          fi
          if [ "$count" -lt 1 ]; then
            echo "No live reels published (count=0). Feed endpoint responds correctly but no content."
            echo "reels_feed=FAIL count=0 marker=$marker"
            exit 1
          else
            echo "reels_feed=PASS count=$count marker=$marker"
          fi

      - name: Verify feed determinism and cache
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          curl -fsS --retry 3 --retry-delay 2 -D /tmp/reels-headers-2.txt "${API_BASE}/api/ivx/video-platform/feed?type=reel&limit=10" -o /tmp/reels-2.json
          ids1=$(jq -c '[.videos[]?.id]' /tmp/reels.json)
          ids2=$(jq -c '[.videos[]?.id]' /tmp/reels-2.json)
          test "$ids1" = "$ids2"
          echo "feed_determinism=PASS"
          grep -i '^x-ivx-cache:' /tmp/reels-headers-2.txt || true

      - name: Verify at least one Reel media asset is playable
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          media_url=$(jq -r '[.. | objects | to_entries[]? | select(.key | test("^(hls_url|video_url|playback_url|media_url)$")) | .value | select(type == "string" and startswith("http"))][0] // empty' /tmp/reels.json)
          if [ -z "$media_url" ]; then
            echo "No playable media URL found (no reels published). HARD FAIL."
            echo "media_playback=FAIL"
            exit 1
          else
            code=$(curl -sS -L --connect-timeout 10 --max-time 30 -H 'Range: bytes=0-1023' -D /tmp/media-headers.txt -o /tmp/media-sample.bin -w '%{http_code}' "$media_url" || true)
            if [ "$code" != "200" ] && [ "$code" != "206" ]; then echo "Reel media HTTP $code"; exit 1; fi
            bytes=$(wc -c < /tmp/media-sample.bin | tr -d ' ')
            if [ "$bytes" -lt 1 ]; then echo "Reel media returned zero bytes"; exit 1; fi
            echo "media_playback=PASS http=$code bytes=$bytes"
          fi

      - name: Verify landing Reels surface
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          code=$(curl -sS -L --connect-timeout 10 --max-time 30 -o /tmp/landing.html -w '%{http_code}' "${LANDING_BASE}/" || true)
          if [ "$code" != "200" ]; then echo "Landing HTTP $code"; exit 1; fi
          grep -Eqi 'reels|ivx-reels' /tmp/landing.html
          echo "landing_reels_surface=PASS"

      - name: Emit Reels live certificate
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          mkdir -p qa/evidence
          count=$(jq -r '.count // (.videos | length) // 0' /tmp/reels.json)
          marker=$(jq -r '.marker // empty' /tmp/reels.json)
          cat > qa/evidence/reels-live-cert.json <<EOF
          {"certified":true,"scope":"IVX Reels live advertising readiness","githubSha":"${GITHUB_SHA}","shaParity":"PASS","health":"PASS","reelsFeed":"PASS","publishedReels":${count},"feedDeterminism":"PASS","mediaPlayback":"PASS","landingReelsSurface":"PASS","platformMarker":"${marker}","verifiedAt":"$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)"}
          EOF
          cat qa/evidence/reels-live-cert.json

      - name: Upload Reels certificate evidence
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: ivx-reels-live-certificate
          path: qa/evidence/reels-live-cert.json

name: IVX Render Live Certificate

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  render-live-cert:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 15
    env:
      RENDER_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.RENDER_API_KEY }}
      RENDER_SERVICE_ID: ${{ secrets.RENDER_SERVICE_ID }}
      IVX_AI_SYSTEM_SECRET: ${{ secrets.IVX_AI_SYSTEM_SECRET }}
      IVX_SYSTEM_SECRET: ${{ secrets.IVX_SYSTEM_SECRET }}
      DEFAULT_RENDER_SERVICE_ID: srv-d7t9ivreo5us73ftose0
      API_BASE: https://api.ivxholding.com
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Resolve deploy mode
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          SERVICE_ID="${RENDER_SERVICE_ID:-$DEFAULT_RENDER_SERVICE_ID}"
          echo "SERVICE_ID=${SERVICE_ID}" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
          if [ -n "${RENDER_API_KEY:-}" ]; then
            echo "DEPLOY_MODE=render_api" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
            echo "Render API secret is bound in GitHub; explicit deploy will be triggered."
          elif [ -n "${IVX_AI_SYSTEM_SECRET:-${IVX_SYSTEM_SECRET:-}}" ]; then
            echo "DEPLOY_MODE=ivx_runtime_bridge" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
            echo "GitHub Render key is absent; using IVX's protected runtime deploy bridge."
          else
            echo "DEPLOY_MODE=auto_deploy" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
            echo "No GitHub deploy credential or IVX system-key bridge is bound; falling back to Render repository auto-deploy."
          fi

      - name: Trigger Render deploy when API binding exists
        id: deploy
        if: env.DEPLOY_MODE == 'render_api'
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          RESPONSE=$(curl -fsS -X POST "https://api.render.com/v1/services/${SERVICE_ID}/deploys" \
            -H "Authorization: Bearer ${RENDER_API_KEY}" \
            -H "Accept: application/json" \
            -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
            --data '{"clearCache":"do_not_clear"}')
          DEPLOY_ID=$(printf '%s' "$RESPONSE" | jq -r '.id // .deploy.id // empty')
          if [ -z "$DEPLOY_ID" ]; then
            echo "Render did not return a deploy id"
            exit 1
          fi
          echo "DEPLOY_ID=$DEPLOY_ID" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
          echo "Triggered Render deploy $DEPLOY_ID"

      - name: Trigger Render deploy through IVX runtime bridge
        id: bridge_deploy
        if: env.DEPLOY_MODE == 'ivx_runtime_bridge'
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          SYSTEM_KEY="${IVX_AI_SYSTEM_SECRET:-${IVX_SYSTEM_SECRET:-}}"
          HTTP=$(curl -sS -m 40 -o /tmp/ivx-render-bridge.json -w '%{http_code}' \
            -X POST "${API_BASE}/api/ivx/developer-deploy/action" \
            -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
            -H "X-IVX-System-Key: ${SYSTEM_KEY}" \
            --data "{\"action\":\"render_trigger_deploy\",\"input\":{\"serviceId\":\"${SERVICE_ID}\",\"commitId\":\"${GITHUB_SHA}\"},\"confirm\":true,\"confirmText\":\"CONFIRM_IVX_RENDER_DEPLOY\",\"reason\":\"GitHub exact-head production certification\"}" || true)
          case "$HTTP" in
            200|201|202) ;;
            *)
              echo "IVX runtime deploy bridge failed with HTTP ${HTTP}."
              jq '{ok,error,message,action,confirmationRequired}' /tmp/ivx-render-bridge.json 2>/dev/null || true
              exit 1
              ;;
          esac
          DEPLOY_ID=$(jq -r '.result.deployId // .result.id // .deployId // empty' /tmp/ivx-render-bridge.json 2>/dev/null || true)
          if [ -n "$DEPLOY_ID" ]; then
            echo "DEPLOY_ID=$DEPLOY_ID" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
            echo "IVX runtime bridge triggered Render deploy $DEPLOY_ID"
          else
            echo "IVX runtime bridge accepted the deploy request; waiting for exact production SHA parity."
          fi

      - name: Wait for explicit Render deploy when API binding exists
        if: env.DEPLOY_MODE == 'render_api'
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          for i in $(seq 1 90); do
            RESPONSE=$(curl -fsS "https://api.render.com/v1/services/${SERVICE_ID}/deploys/${DEPLOY_ID}" \
              -H "Authorization: Bearer ${RENDER_API_KEY}" \
              -H "Accept: application/json")
            STATUS=$(printf '%s' "$RESPONSE" | jq -r '.status // empty')
            COMMIT=$(printf '%s' "$RESPONSE" | jq -r '.commit.id // .commitId // empty')
            echo "poll=$i status=$STATUS commit=${COMMIT:0:12}"
            if [ "$STATUS" = "live" ]; then
              echo "RENDER_COMMIT=$COMMIT" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
              exit 0
            fi
            if [ "$STATUS" = "build_failed" ] || [ "$STATUS" = "update_failed" ] || [ "$STATUS" = "canceled" ]; then
              echo "Render deploy failed with status=$STATUS"
              exit 1
            fi
            sleep 5
          done
          echo "Timed out waiting for explicit Render deploy"
          exit 1

      - name: Wait for production SHA parity
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          matched=0
          for i in $(seq 1 72); do
            code=$(curl -sS -m 20 -o /tmp/health.json -w '%{http_code}' "${API_BASE}/health" || true)
            if [ "$code" = "200" ]; then
              HEALTH_COMMIT=$(jq -r '.commit // .sha // .gitCommit // .git_commit // empty' /tmp/health.json 2>/dev/null || true)
              OK=$(jq -r '.ok // false' /tmp/health.json 2>/dev/null || echo false)
              echo "poll=$i health=$OK production_sha=${HEALTH_COMMIT:-missing} expected=${GITHUB_SHA}"
              if [ "$OK" = "true" ] && { [ "$HEALTH_COMMIT" = "$GITHUB_SHA" ] || [[ "$GITHUB_SHA" == "$HEALTH_COMMIT"* ]] || [[ "$HEALTH_COMMIT" == "$GITHUB_SHA"* ]]; }; then
                matched=1
                echo "RENDER_COMMIT=$HEALTH_COMMIT" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
                break
              fi
            else
              echo "poll=$i health_http=$code"
            fi
            sleep 10
          done
          if [ "$matched" != "1" ]; then
            echo "Production never reached current main SHA ${GITHUB_SHA}."
            exit 1
          fi
          echo "sha_parity=PASS"

      - name: Verify production health
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          HEALTH=$(cat /tmp/health.json)
          printf '%s\n' "$HEALTH" | jq '.'
          OK=$(printf '%s' "$HEALTH" | jq -r '.ok // false')
          if [ "$OK" != "true" ]; then
            echo "Production /health did not return ok=true"
            exit 1
          fi
          echo "health=PASS"

      - name: Verify AI provider status (public endpoint) — HARD GATE
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          AI_HEALTH=$(curl -sS --retry 4 --retry-delay 2 "${API_BASE}/health/ai/live" || echo '{}')
          printf '%s\n' "$AI_HEALTH" | jq '.' || true
          AI_OK=$(printf '%s' "$AI_HEALTH" | jq -r '.ok // false')
          if [ "$AI_OK" = "true" ]; then
            echo "ai_provider=PASS (AI gateway is live)"
          else
            REASON=$(printf '%s' "$AI_HEALTH" | jq -r '.reason // .error // "unknown"')
            echo "AI gateway is not ready: $REASON"
            echo "ai_provider=FAIL (gateway not configured)"
            exit 1
          fi

      - name: Verify public chat endpoint responds — HARD GATE
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          RESPONSE=$(curl -fsS --retry 3 --retry-delay 2 -X POST "${API_BASE}/api/public/chat" \
            -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
            --data '{"message":"Return only the number: what is 17 plus 25?","sessionId":"github-live-cert","requestId":"github-live-cert-'"${GITHUB_RUN_ID}"'","history":[]}')
          SOURCE=$(printf '%s' "$RESPONSE" | jq -r '.source // empty')
          ANSWER=$(printf '%s' "$RESPONSE" | jq -r '.answer // .text // empty')
          if [ -z "$ANSWER" ]; then
            echo "No AI answer returned — HARD FAIL"
            exit 1
          fi
          if [ "$SOURCE" = "fallback" ]; then
            echo "Public chat returned fallback. HARD FAIL."
            echo "live_inference=FAIL"
            exit 1
          else
            echo "Live AI inference passed; source=${SOURCE:-unknown}"
            echo "live_inference=PASS"
          fi

      - name: Emit certificate evidence
        shell: bash
        run: |
          mkdir -p qa/evidence
          cat > qa/evidence/render-live-cert.json <<EOF
          {
            "certified": true,
            "githubSha": "${GITHUB_SHA}",
            "deployMode": "${DEPLOY_MODE}",
            "renderDeployId": "${DEPLOY_ID:-bridge-or-auto}",
            "renderCommit": "${RENDER_COMMIT:-}",
            "health": "PASS",
            "shaParity": "PASS",
            "verifiedAt": "$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)"
          }
          EOF
          cat qa/evidence/render-live-cert.json

      - name: Upload live certificate evidence
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: ivx-render-live-certificate
          path: qa/evidence/render-live-cert.json

Let me continue with the task. I need to resolve the merge conflict from the stash pop and push all my fixes to GitHub. The stash pop created conflicts because `.rork/history/` files were deleted in the cert-fixes branch (from latest GitHub main which already had the removal) but my stashed changes also tried to delete them.

Let me resolve this properly.
Let me resolve the conflicts and push the fixes cleanly.

cd /home/user/rork-app
# The conflicts are all .rork/history files — we want them GONE (deleted)
# Resolve all conflicts by removing .rork/history files

# For all conflicted .rork/history files, remove them
git status --short | grep "^DU\|^DD\|^AU\|^UA" | awk '{print $2}' | xargs -r git rm --force 2>/dev/null || true

# Reset the stash
git stash drop 2>/dev/null || true

echo "=== Status after conflict resolution ==="
git status --short | head -10
echo "..."
git status --short | wc -l
